title: Web Area Callbacks in v14
author: Timothy Aaron PENNER, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION / WA EVALUATE JAVASCRIPT

historical_commentary.text: The v14 WebKit-based Web Area and its $4d JavaScript callback bridge were the standard way to embed rich HTML/JS content with two-way 4D communication for years; this remains functional in later 4D versions, though newer options like offscreen web areas and, more broadly, ORDA/REST-driven external web front ends have shifted where developers do this kind of integration.
related_updates: Offscreen Web Areas (introduced later, e.g. v18 R3-era) for headless HTML/JS processing
Continued WebKit-engine improvements in subsequent 4D versions kept the $4d callback mechanism current
REST/ORDA-based external web apps as an alternative architecture to embedding a Web Area inside a 4D form
